article.p: Prepared by Core Infrastructure Engineering — November 3, 2026

Across Q4 2026, global API availability reached 99.982%, exceeding the 99.95% quarterly objective. Peak ingress traffic grew 18.4% quarter-over-quarter to 412,000 requests per second during the October regional failover drill with zero customer-visible packet loss.

ul.li: Zero P1 incidents: Automated canary rollback intercepted 3 faulty configuration pushes under 45 seconds.
Database read-replica tail latency: P99 decreased from 14.2 ms to 8.7 ms after NVMe queue tuning.
Headroom verification: All three primary regions sustained N+1 zone loss at 130% synthetic load.
